notes: CLOSEST CONFIRMED CLARK COUNTY FRY TO WAUSAU - easy Hwy 29 run. Friday fish fry specials named in listings. Supersedes the crowdsourced guide's 'Wild Life Bar & Grill' at N14375 County Rd E, which appears to be its predecessor.
On the Clark County side of Unity per the county EDC 2026 directory. Friday fish fry dinners cited in reviews.
Friday fry alongside live music, karaoke, pool and darts. Do not confuse with the unrelated Midway Bar & Restaurant near Butternut.
Also trades as Rumour's Supperclub. Steakhouse-style menu; Friday fry described as crispy and fresh. Only confirmed fry in Loyal.
Country bar outside Greenwood, cited for a 'famous Friday fish fry'. Phone per Clark County EDC 2026 (the fish fry guide's number looks stale).
9-hole public course; own site states the kitchen serves a Friday Fish Fry 4:30-9PM. CAVEAT WORTH PRINTING: if the course closes for weather the kitchen closes too - call ahead.
Pool-hall bar and grill east of Owen; Friday fry called out in listings and reviews. Occupies the old Thirsty Squirrel address, so that guide entry is superseded.
Also Chili Corners Club. Decades-old crossroads bar on Hwy 10; Friday fry is its signature, corroborated by Travel Wisconsin, Tripadvisor and Yelp.
MOST SPECIFIC FISH DESCRIPTION IN THE COUNTY: Atlantic cod loins hand-breaded in a house coating, deep fried, Fridays only 4-8PM. Also homemade pizza. Sometimes listed as R & C Roadhouse.
Appears variously as Hilltop Tavern, Hilltop Bar & Grill of Granton and Tommy's Hilltop; the county EDC 2026 directory calls it The New Hilltop Bar. Friday fry repeatedly praised.
Country roadhouse south of Thorp operating since the 1970s; broasted chicken plus a Friday fry. Closed Mon-Wed.
Classic supper club 5 mi east of Neillsville on Hwy 10, motel on the same property. Friday fry repeatedly cited; walleye named. Strong sponsor prospect.
On Rock Dam Lake. Reviews cite a Friday fry with cod. Confirmed still operating in the county EDC 2026 directory and the City of Greenwood dining list.
BEST-DOCUMENTED FRY IN THE COUNTY - own website publishes the Friday menu: Atlantic cod, walleye filet, beer-battered perch, bluegill and buttermilk shrimp, plus a salad bar.
Family restaurant on Hwy 73/Hill St. Friday fry described as cod, walleye and haddock. In the county EDC 2026 directory as Thorpedo Restaurant.
Downtown breakfast-and-lunch cafe that stays open Friday evening for a fish fry.

venue_name: Apple Valley Road Haus and Event Center
notes: Deep-fried cod and a baked lemon-pepper option on the Friday fry. Also an event center. Phone confirmed against the Clark County EDC 2026 directory.
Formerly Wildcat Inn. Family-owned, meats smoked in-house. 'Friday Night Fish Fry' named across Travel Wisconsin, Yelp and Tripadvisor.
FAR OUT - ~82 miles, far southwest corner of the county. Travel Wisconsin names a Friday Night Fish Fry among nightly specials. Restored historic hotel with rooms.

Truck-stop family restaurant at the Abbyland Travel Center. On the crowdsourced guide but the venue's own page advertises only all-day breakfast and general dining. Worth a call purely for the short distance.
Successor at 522 W Mill St to the Hayloft Bar, which the crowdsourced guide flags as permanently closed - treat that Hayloft entry as dead. Fry listed but unconfirmed.
On the crowdsourced guide and open late Fridays, but no source confirms a fry. One of three Main Street bars in Loyal worth a single round of calls.
Newer Loyal tavern (opened ~2024) serving appetizers, burgers, wraps and pizza. A Tavern League listing shows a Friday Fish Fry amenity flag but could not be tied to this record with certainty.
Barbecue house on Hwy 73. On the crowdsourced guide and the county EDC directory, but nothing else indicates a Friday fry.
Prohibition-era lower-level tavern in the restored Woodland Hotel. Yelp files it under Fish & Chips and it appears on the Clark guide, but no venue source confirms a Friday fry.

CURRENT OPERATOR at the address the crowdsourced guide still lists as 'The Sawmill Saloon' (Travel Wisconsin's Sawmill URL now redirects here). BEWARE: a circulating 'broasted or baked cod or Canadian walleye' description for a Sawmill Saloon belongs to a different bar in Seeley, WI.
Bar and bowling alley, known locally for the Blue Mirror Burger. Phone conflict: city page 715-267-6175 vs county EDC 715-267-6359 - verify.
Rural bar outside Owen, confirmed open in the county EDC 2026 directory. Fry claim rests only on the crowdsourced guide.

venue_name: The Buck N' Doe Bar and Grill
notes: Current operator at the address the crowdsourced guide also lists as 'Polzin's Pub N Grub' - same phone, so that entry is stale. Tavern League member. No fry source.
Formerly Mapleworks Cafe & Bar. Travel Wisconsin describes 'a wonderful selection of seafood' but names no Friday fry. Do not confuse with a closed Granton Inn in Michigan.
Formerly Boone's Bar & Grill / The Hitchin Rail / Call of the Wild. On the crowdsourced guide only. NAME COLLISION: not the same as The Office Bar in Schofield.
NAME CONFLICT - the City of Greenwood dining page lists this address as 'Ernie's Rock Dam Saloon' while the county EDC directory still says Cal's. Verify the current name before publishing.
Downtown Thorp saloon, confirmed open in the county EDC 2026 directory. Fry claim rests only on the crowdsourced guide.
Casual downtown bar. On the crowdsourced guide only; reviews mention beer and bartenders, not food.
On the crowdsourced guide only. Phone corrected per the county EDC 2026 directory - the guide's number is actually Mesquite Grill & Pub's.
Small-town bar and grill on Hwy 10. On the crowdsourced guide and county EDC directory, but no fry source found.
Public golf course clubhouse. Menu offers deep-fried or broiled fish with soup or salad and a potato, but the day of service is not published.
Listed as known for fish fry alongside burgers, prime rib and tacos, but no source states a Friday fry specifically. Busy downtown Neillsville room.
Bowling center with a full kitchen. Fish fry surfaces in review snippets but no source states it directly. Bowling centers are a reliable category, so worth the call.
Menu carries a 'Swimming with the Fish' section - hand-dipped 2 or 3 piece fish dinners plus walleye - and reviews mention grilled fish on Fridays, but no dedicated Friday fry advertised.
FAR OUT - ~82 miles, same far-southwest pocket as the Humbird Hotel. Has its own website. On the crowdsourced guide but no fry confirmed.
